$comment: Same words, different meanings. Jodee types the Accord summon; the conductor walks the three agents through it, a popover saying what each step does; 'ships' and 'never lost' come back used in different senses, the flow goes round restate, and product changes its mind on screen; the shared summary pins the words down. A spotlight, not the camera, picks out each beat.
do: wait-text:Offline mode is our most requested feature

eval:(() => { const s = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Resize the open tabs"]'); if (!s) return; const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); s.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, clientX: r.x, clientY: r.y + 10 })); const box = s.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect(); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: box.left + box.width * 0.38 })); window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {})); })()

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; window.__follow = true; window.__scroller = n; const go = () => window.__follow && n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
